Name: Global Warfare
Overview:
This is an online first person shooter game, where you play free for all against up to 7 other players or bots, play on 6 unique multiplayer maps and rank yourself up to become General of the Army.

Mission coop 4 players. Play up to 4 player split screen local or online, and if you have a 3D tv, you can even play the game in 3D.
